page.overview:
What is Amavet Fortress Ruins?

The ruins can only be entered by climbing and jumping onto rocky cliffs and building parts of the fortress.

It was used by a local lord called Ignatius Verrieres who detained and interrogated the witcher Kolgrim of the Viper School over an alleged kidnapping of a boy. For unknown reasons, it was left neglected and is now in ruins. A group of bandits have later made camp there.
